review_comments:
Wouldn't it make more sense to put this before the foreach loop, or even change the `else if` to
`else if (frame == 0 && !disposed)`?

The key point here is that `ProcessOrder` call can cause the `OrderManager` to be disposed, and we want to bail out ASAP once that happens to avoid doing something that will crash.

We therefore do need this here, but will need an extra check at the top to make sure we don't process any other orders either.
Doh, this is what lack of sleep does to a man.
style nit: can we please put braces around this to avoid the hanging block?
